_comment: Localised family names and the legal records, keyed by PostScript name. Kept out of the source so the code stays pure ASCII. Language tags are Windows LCIDs. The monospace suffix stays ASCII 'Mono' even in the Chinese names, so that a font merged locally by sbitgraft - which cannot know the word in any other language - lands on exactly the same name table as the build here.
author: The GlowSong Authors
_legal_comment: name IDs 0, 13 and 14. Both upstream licences require their notice to travel with the font, so these are not decoration. Source Han Serif reserves 'Source' and Liberation reserves 'Liberation'; neither word appears anywhere in this font's names, which is what OFL clause 3 asks. The outline and bitmap sides are distributed separately and never meet in one file, so each carries only the notices of what went into it.
